release_policy: Numerical attributes unchanged from v1.0; no rounding or replacement of category means. Recommended flags are conditional usability guidance, not validation of each source or catchment.

aggregation.support: Intersecting HydroBASINS level12 polygons, read from final GDB layer; intersect in projected CRS (UTM estimated from watershed centroid when source CRS is geographic).
aggregation.formula: sum_i(area_i*value_ij)/sum_i(area_i) over retained intersections carrying non-NaN value j, then divide specified scaled fields by10 or100.
aggregation.missing_values: Source -9999 replaced by NaN. Normalization is variable-specific over available values. Current code uses ~isnan rather than isfinite; equivalence to finite-value normalization assumes no infinities in source attributes.
aggregation.historical_provenance: scripts/renormalize_hydroatlas_attributes.py also documents dividing older aggregate values by area_fraction_used; that shortcut equals variable-specific normalization only when retained source polygons have no per-variable missing values. This metadata amendment does not certify a source-level re-extraction of every frozen attribute.
